column3: Bose QuietComfort 45 Bluetooth Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones
column7: The lightweight design and plush synthetic earcups make these the most comfortable headphones for 8-hour flights. ANC drowns out jet engine roar completely.

column6: Crystal clear voice calls and physical buttons
column7: Having tactile physical volume and track buttons instead of finicky touch sliders is a huge plus. Microphone isolates speech well in busy coffee shops.

column3: Bose QuietComfort 45 Bluetooth Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones
column7: Battery life easily meets the 24-hour claim. Sound profile is balanced with crisp highs and controlled bass.

column6: Bass is lacking compared to Sony XM4
